class BinaryTree

  end

    n = @root
    while true
      if key < n.key

          break
        end

        end

    @list

    # 帰りがけ順探索(左下から順に)

    traverse(@root, :post)
    @list
  end

    @list << node.key if type == :pre
    traverse(node.left, type) if node.left
    @list << node.key if type == :in
    traverse(node.right, type) if node.right

  end
